note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 in Ballyclug, Broughshane, Galgorm and Portglenone only. The other divisions were filled unopposed: sixteen are named from the nomination list (Ballymena Observer, 6 May 1927, p. 10) and the withdrawals report (13 May 1927, p. 10). Slemish, Toome and Tullaghgarley are not printed in the reports traced. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
